name: Quiet Inbox
tagline: Archives Gmail promo mail and junk, then drafts a Sunday week-ahead note
description: It sweeps promotional mail and outright junk out of your Gmail inbox into the archive, and it never deletes anything. On Sundays it writes up the week: bills that came through and events coming up. Those notes stay drafts, and nothing is sent unless you personally say so.
author: signalnoise8020
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
